content: Phala post-mortem 2026-10-19: Oct 8-12 2026 attacker exploited dstack guest-agent /logs/<container> path injection (bollard) via public gateway route to read container logs + Config.Env of tenant apps; plus CVM-to-host SLIRP network gap reached unauthenticated host mgmt APIs and stole a gateway admin token (shared across gateways; token also logged from URL query string). TEE/KMS keys, disks, hosts unaffected. Fixes: dstack 0.6.1/0.5.12, default-deny host firewall, unique tokens, public_logs off. Source: phala.com/posts/2026-10-post-mortem-dstack-guest-agent-vulnerability.
